reset.title: Create a new password
reset.short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

done.resetNext: Your password has been changed. Tap Continue to finish signing in.
done.resetMsg: Your password has been changed. If your account stores encrypted notes, finish in “Recover access” with your seed phrase.
done.verifiedMsg: All set! Your email has been confirmed. You can now sign in to your account.
done.recoverMsg: Your account's sign-in email has been restored to the previous one. For security, we recommend changing your password now.

recover.sent: We sent a link to reset your password. Check your spam folder too.

error.title: This link could not be used

errors.expired: This link has expired. Request a new email and use the most recent link.
errors.invalid: This link is invalid or has already been used. If needed, request a new email.
errors.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact support.
errors.notFound: We could not find the account for this link.
errors.weak: This password is weak. Use at least 10 characters, mixing letters and numbers.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Could not complete this. Try again or request a new email.
